_meta.purpose: Defines all user journeys and their CCC audit state. Single source of truth for audit progress. Claude reads and updates every session.
_meta.claudeSessionRule: On session start: start with currentAuditJourney. If that journey is not CERT-SEALED and not explicitly CERT-BLOCKED by a documented code gap, continue that same journey. If actions[] is empty, lastAuditedAction is null, or CLAUDE_CURRENT_STATE.journeyExecutionMachineState.auditMode=USER_ACTION_ENUMERATION, first reiterate the journey, enumerate the full real-user action list, build the cross-layer map, and build the edge-case matrix before any blocker implementation. Otherwise resume from lastAuditedAction + 1 or from the recorded remaining sealing blocker. If posSuiteLock.status=LOCKED, stay inside posSuiteLock.journeyOrder and do not switch to non-POS journeys. If postPosPlatformLock.status starts with LOCKED_TO_, stay inside postPosPlatformLock.journeyOrder and do not switch ahead of the active platform. Update this file after EVERY action. Never end session without updating.
_meta.lifecycleRule: Before asking for any operator action or artifact build, Claude must state which lifecycle phase is active from CLAUDE_CURRENT_STATE.productionGradeCertificationModel.liveTestingLifecycle. Baseline live discovery and post-fix runtime certification are different phases and may not be conflated.
_meta.depthFirstAuditRule: One journey at a time, to 100% completion. Claude may move currentAuditJourney only when the current journey is CERT-SEALED, PARK-READY, or when it is CERT-BLOCKED with exact blocker, requiredFix, and next-resume conditions documented in repo truth. If posSuiteLock.status=LOCKED, Claude may move only to the next POS journey in posSuiteLock.journeyOrder until the full POS suite is complete. If postPosPlatformLock.status starts with LOCKED_TO_, Claude may move only according to postPosPlatformLock.journeyOrder and the active platform switch rules. 'Round not enough' is not a valid reason to switch journeys.
_meta.roundBudgetRule: If a session ends mid-journey, Claude records exact remaining blockers, next action, active audit mode, and next layer, then resumes the same journey next session. Claude does not start sampling the next journey while the active one is still auditable.
_meta.prerequisiteFunnelRule: If a journey depends on upstream registration, login, approval/provisioning, enrollment, or stock-setup flows, Claude must map and stabilize that full real-user prerequisite funnel before asking the operator to certify the downstream journey.
_meta.surfaceDeployGateRule: A touched surface (retailer-admin, supplier-portal, superadmin, POS) cannot request deploy/APK until its real-user auth/onboarding matrix and deterministic regression gates pass on the candidate.
_meta.posSuiteFirstRule: POS app is the locked primary surface. 15 POS journeys (J01,J07,J08,J05,J02,J03,J04,J06,J13-J19) constitute the exhaustive POS journey inventory after second-pass coverage proof.
_meta.journeyMachineStateRule: Whenever currentAuditJourney changes or the active audit mode changes, sync RELEASES/CLAUDE_CURRENT_STATE.json journeyExecutionMachineState in the same STATE_ONLY truth update before more work begins.
_meta.newJourneyEntryRule: If a journey has actions.length === 0, lastAuditedAction == null, or journeyExecutionMachineState.auditMode=USER_ACTION_ENUMERATION, Claude must first reiterate the journey from repo truth, enumerate every real user click/action, build the cross-layer map, and write the edge-case matrix before choosing or implementing any blocker.

sealingBlockers.B11_unpushedCandidateBlock: Journey cannot collect operator certification runtimeEvidence or reach CERT-SEALED if the candidate code SHA or active machine-state/framework SHA is not present on origin/main.
sealingBlockers.B12_wrongLifecyclePhaseBlock: Journey cannot collect runtimeEvidence, request deploy/APK, or claim certification if the action is being performed in the wrong liveTestingLifecycle phase. falseSealprevention: CERT-SEALED requires ALL 6 guarantees signed=true with citations.
Each citation must be a file:line reference, not a description.
G1 cannot be signed until every file in scopeFiles has been confirmed read (readings may span sessions; all must be verified and explicitly confirmed in the signing session).
G4 cannot be signed until every touched invariant entry is VERIFIED with file:line.
runtimeEvidence must contain at least one OPERATOR_CONFIRMED entry per action before journey is eligible for CERT-SEALED.
No action can be result=PASS without L2 citations (code path trace) completed.
No journey can be CERT-SEALED without crossPortalMatrix fully verified (all rows have verified=true).

Every runtimeEvidence entry MUST contain all 12 immutable fields in runtimeEvidenceSchema (evidenceType, step, capturedAt, capturedSha, seedVersion, deviceId, storeId, artifactPath, summary, result, actualOutcome, operatorConfirmed). Entries missing capturedSha, seedVersion, deviceId, or storeId are INVALID.
Every accepted-risk waiver MUST be a formal acceptedRisk object with all 8 fields. A freeform notes string is NOT a valid waiver.
Claude CANNOT self-approve (approvedBy=CLAUDE_AUDIT) any waiver where severity=HIGH or severity=CRITICAL. These require approvedBy=OPERATOR or approvedBy=CTO before sealing is permitted.
A code-fix commit that mixed product code with RELEASES/, workflow/state/, or RELEASES/LIVE_TESTING_ISSUES.md is NOT closure-eligible until separated or explicitly waived as a cluster exception.
Operator-confirmed runtime evidence is INVALID unless both the candidate code SHA and active machine-state/framework SHA are pushed to origin/main.
Claude must not switch currentAuditJourney while the active journey is still auditable. Finish the current journey's sealing blockers or document an explicit CERT-BLOCKED stop condition first.
